title: TestableUIKit Scenario Schema
description: Schema for a declarative UI scenario (a sequence of action/testID/parameters/expect steps).

steps.description: Array of steps to execute in order from the first.

action.description: Command to execute. Universal: getState / setProperty | Component-specific: tap / increment / decrement / reset / toggle / clear / setEnabled

testID.description: testID of the target component (e.g. scene.demo.counter, scene.auth.loginButton).

parameters.description: Command parameters (optional). setProperty requires { "key": string, "value": any } format. Usually omitted for other commands.

expect.description: Assert key/expected-value pairs after execution (optional). Accepts both the five fixed keys (isEnabled / title / isHidden / alpha / backgroundColor) and component-specific keys (count / isOn / label / value / text, etc.).
